text:
There are three methods to achieve this kind of animation on Seedance 2.
• use just one image as ref and prompt to get the result. 
• Storyboard. 
• First and second Frame (Keyframe).

The 3rd one will render consistent results without wasting your credits. 

Made on @magnific (Freepik) Seedance 2, Prompt and image ref in comments.
content:
Use Seedance 2’s First and Second Frame (Keyframe) method to get more consistent animation results while avoiding wasted credits.  
Use JSON-structured prompts in Seedance 2 to force the model to follow your intended scene/camera/timeline more exactly, especially since it’s an expensive model.  
Lock the camera (fixed/locked movement) in your prompt to maintain consistent framing throughout the animation.  
Add a timestamped timeline (e.g., 0–2s, 2–5s, etc.) describing actions beat-by-beat to control pacing and comedic timing.
